spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

** ¶2**

Observe that the Most Ancient Church was vast in its spiritual capacity, and the fullness of its wisdom was imm ense. Its states of life were abundant beyond measure. That earliest humanity dw elt for many complete cycles within the realm of spiritual experience. Nor was it alone in its great ness; all who descended from its spiritual lineage likewise possessed abundant states of perception and life . Yet those who come into spiritual existence in the present age find their capacity diminished in strength , and their states of interior life are shortened . Why is the manner of spiritual regener ation today — by which new states of the church come into being — so altered from that of the earliest celest ial humanity? For the kn owledges of good and truth, and the fundamental spiritual dispositions ordained in the heavens, remain in their established order . Why then have the full ness and the states of life belonging to these last generations grown so small , and why has the human spirit itself become lesser , compared with those ancient ones who belonged to the first ages of the church?

---

**¶3**

The spiritual states of humanity have expanded , have turned through their successive ages , and have contracted — because there are five degrees of governing infl ux appointed within the arrangement of the external mind and the interior heav ens above it. These degrees are known by their names: the first is the complete cycle of spiritual life; the second is a lesser full ness of spiritual life ; the third is a single illumin ated state; the fourth is a brief opening of perception ; the fifth is a momentary touch of awareness . Now, these five degrees and these five dwelling - states exist within the order of the external and internal mind. In each degree res ides a distinct spiritual power , and each is made sovereign over its domain . There is a ruling love that gov erns the full est cycle ; a ruling love that governs the lesser fullness; a ruling love that governs the single illuminated state; a ruling love that governs the brief perception ; a ruling love that governs the passing moment. Each stands above its companion in succession , and the higher is made sovereign over the one beneath it.

---

**¶ 4**

In this way the human understanding comes into existence , and the aff ections alongside it. They are brought forth under the governance of these successive powers . And these governing powers have held domin ion from the first establishment of the church until its final state. Now, in the beginning of the spiritual ages , those powers that governed the full est and most complete cycles of interior life held sovereignty . Therefore the goods and truths born under their governance, during those generations and their era , were found to possess the greatest abundance of spiritual life . They attained a vast full ness of perception in the age of the Most Ancient Church, and in that of its first spiritual poster ity, and in the line age that descended from them.

---

** ¶5**

After they ceased to reign — those sovereign powers that governed the complete cycles of spiritual life — the powers governing the lesser fullness of spiritual life themselves assumed dominion. As the lesser full ness is less than the complete cycle , so too it is with the goods and truths born under their governance. The spiritual life of what they produced is less than the life of what was brought forth under the sovereignty of the powers that governed the full est states .

---

**¶6**

When the authority of the powers governing the lesser fullness was completed, the powers of the single illuminated state received domin ion after them. Therefore, as a single illuminated state is less than a sustained full ness, so it is with the goods and truths brought forth under their governance. Their spiritual life is less than that of what was born under the powers of the sustained fullness. And again , even so with what was brought forth under the brief perception and the passing moment — what they produce is less still than what arose from the sustained fullness or the single illuminated state.

---

** ¶7**

The spiritual life of humanity has contracted nearly to nothing. Its illumin ated states have diminished. Its cycles of interior life have grown few — because the love and the wisdom that were present in the world of human experience during the first ages of the church were far greater than what exists today. Indeed, for this reason has the spiritual capacity of humanity become smaller . The full ness of its interior life has been taken from it.

---

**¶ 9**

Now consider this further question : By what manner of spiritual generation was the whole poster ity of the church brought forth from a single will and a single understanding — from one love and one wisdom joined as one?

---

**¶10**

The nature of those earliest spiritual generations is that they were richer in wisdom and more complete in their capacity for receiving the Divine . Their states of interior life were greater in number and extent . Thus also , the goods and truths they brought forth were far more abundant than what the present church produces. Their interior states remained longer in the deep places of conception within the will before coming to out ward expression. And from a single interior state of the will, many distinct goods and truths were born into manifest ation. At times five living tru ths came forth from one conce iving state, and at times six — some fewer , some more . Indeed, for this very reason the goods and truths desc ending from the Most Ancient Church, and from its spiritual children , filled the whole natural mind of humanity by reason of that line age alone . For what the earliest ages of the church conceived and brought forth into the world of human experience differs imm ensely from what is produced today. The manner of their interior conception and their bringing - forth into life is nothing like the dimin ished and external generation by which the present church produces its few and f eeble tru ths.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Now, no[te] that Adam is mighty in his stature, and great is his size. Even his years are many! He spent many years living in the world. And he is not the only one we have found to be mighty; but all the others who were begotten in his generation, many are their years too. Still, these people who are born today, their stature has been diminished in power; even their years are lessened. Also, why is the birth today, of [the]y who are born, altered compared with that of these first [ones? Not one star has turned from] place to place? See, even the stars and signs of the zodiac continue in their positions. Why now have the age and the years of these last ones diminished, and he has also become smaller, compared to these ancient ones who belong to these first generations?

They increased, have turned, and diminished; because there are five types of authorities and leaders appointed in the sphere of zodiacal signs, and the heavens above it. They have names they are ca[lled] by: the first name is the year; the sec[on]d is the month; the third is the day; the fou[rth] is the hour; the fifth is the moment. Now, these five positions, and these five houses, exist in the sphere and the heavens. These places have five powers, and they are made masters over them. The master of the year exists; the master of the month exists; the master of the day exists; the master of the hour exists; the master of the moment exists. In turn one is above his companion; and in turn the one above is made the master over the one below him.

So, mankind is begotten, and [the ani]mals. They are born in these powers. And, thus, these powers have received authority since the beginning of creation till the end of the world. Now, in the beginning of the generations the powers who were masters over the years reigned. Therefore, because of this, the offspring born in their generations and their lifetime: their years were found to be greater. They attain a long life span in the generation of Adam, and [tha]t of Sethel his son, and that of the ones who came after him.

After they ceased to reign, namely the powers who are masters over the years; the powers who are masters over the months themselves reigned. Like the months, for they are less than the years; again this [is] also the case with the offspring w[ho were] born in them. Their life span is less [than the life span of the ones born] in the generation of the powers who master the years!

When the authority of the powers who master the months was completed; the powers of the days received authority after them. Therefore, like the days, for they are less than the months, this also is the case with the offspring who were born in them. Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months. Again, even so the offspring who were born in the hours, and of the moments. Their conduit is less than that of the months and the days.

For the manner of these first generations is that they are richer in their light and purer in stature. Even their years are greater. Thus, again, even their offspring is much more than the offspring of this tim[e]. They were spending a longer time [ ... ] in [the w]omb of their mother. Afterwards, they [ ... ] a number in a single womb. There are times five were brought forth from a single womb, and times six were brought forth from [a] single womb! There are some lesser than this; again, some greater than this. Indeed, because of this the offspring of Eve multiplied, and of her children. The earth was filled by reason of them alone; because the offspring from the generation of the people of old, who they bore into the world, differ greatly from those of today. Their conception and their birth is not like latter births, brought forth nowadays from the woman's uterus.
